summary.intent: Add Vercel deployment detection to the `entire enable` and `entire configure` commands so that after agents are enabled, the CLI checks for Vercel config and offers to disable deployments for `entire/*` branches in `vercel.json`.
summary.outcome: A `maybePromptVercelDeploymentDisable` helper was added to `setup.go` with proper JSON merge logic and three call sites covering all agent-enable paths. A follow-up fix removed a spurious blank line after the 'Updated vercel.json' message. Targeted tests pass; full suite was not run.

repo: The three agent-enable entry points are `runEnableInteractive`, `setupAgentHooksNonInteractive`, and `applyAgentChanges` in `cmd/entire/cli/setup.go`.
Interactive prompt style (e.g. `huh.NewConfirm`, `NewAccessibleForm`) and file I/O helpers are defined in `cmd/entire/cli/utils.go`.
A blank spacer before the telemetry prompt in `runEnableInteractive` was unconditional, causing stray empty lines when no telemetry prompt was shown.
Non-interactive runs (e.g. `--agent` flag path) require a print-note fallback instead of an interactive prompt.

code.finding: Agent enable interactive flow entry point; post-install hook for Vercel prompt was inserted here.
Bulk of agent management logic including `applyAgentChanges` — second call site for Vercel helper.
Non-interactive agent setup path (`setupAgentHooksNonInteractive`) — third call site.
Telemetry spacer logic; the unconditional blank line here caused the empty-line bug after 'Updated vercel.json'.
Shared file I/O and prompt helpers referenced for consistency when implementing the new helper.
Existing setup test patterns used as reference for structuring the new Vercel helper tests.

workflow: Targeted test runs (`-run 'TestFoo|TestBar'`) with an isolated GOCACHE were used throughout to avoid rebuilding the full binary on each iteration.
gofmt was run as a discrete step after each patch rather than relying on editor integration.
A `git diff` review of the two modified files was done after tests passed to sanity-check call-site placement before declaring done.

friction: The first `go test` invocation hung and never returned output, requiring multiple `write_stdin` attempts and an eventual rerun in a simpler form.
The blank-line regression was only caught via a screenshot from the user, not by the existing test suite — tests do not assert on stdout formatting of the enable flow.
open_items: Full repo test suite was not run; only the targeted `TestMaybePromptVercelDeploymentDisable`, `TestManageAgents_AddAndRemove`, `TestRunEnable`, and `TestConfigureCmd` tests were verified.
Tests cover the merge logic and detection cases but do not assert on the exact terminal output format, so future blank-line regressions would again require manual visual inspection.
